subject: Fix appendEvent O(n) rewrite + add daemon robustness handlers
description:
Two verified robustness gaps in /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid:

A) lib/graph-store.js appendEvent() (~line 30-42) does read-whole-file → concat line → write tmp → rename for EVERY event append. That's O(file size) per append and loses events if two processes append concurrently. FIRST investigate why it was written this way (git log/blame on the function — likely crash-safety so a partial write never corrupts the JSONL). Then replace with fs.appendFileSync(dest, line) — a single appendFileSync of one line is effectively atomic for this size on POSIX and crash-safe (worst case: one truncated trailing line, which loadGraph should already tolerate — verify it skips malformed trailing lines, and add that tolerance if missing). Keep behavior identical otherwise. Update/extend test/graph-store.test.js to cover append + malformed-trailing-line tolerance.

B) daemon.js robustness: (1) add a process.on('unhandledRejection') handler near startup that logs the error to stderr (do NOT exit — daemon should stay up); (2) graceful shutdown: on SIGTERM/SIGINT, call server.close() with a ~5s drain timeout before exit, keeping the existing removeDaemonPort behavior (~line 3346).

Run existing graph-store and app-restart tests after. Edit daemon.js via /tmp+cp if the write gate requires (claim this task via start_task first — that unlocks writes for your session).
